snippet.title: Formula Legends Gameplay Trailer - Future Games Show Summer Showcase 2025
snippet.description:
A rip-roaring gameplay trailer for Formula Legends debuted in this year’s Summer Showcase. It’s a retro racer from 3DClouds that propels you through the history of motorsport, and it’s coming soon to PC and consoles. There’s also a demo available on PC if you’d like to get behind the wheel.

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS #formulalegends

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
